Caption / Script:
Signal — Tune Into Your Inner Self

Your cycle changes everything. Your energy, your mood, your sleep, your hunger. Signal is the first wellness app built around this truth — giving you personalised guidance for every phase of your cycle, every day.

--- WHAT SIGNAL DOES ---

🌙 CYCLE SYNCING
Track your cycle and get daily insights on how your hormones affect your body and mind. Understand your follicular, ovulatory, luteal, and menstrual phases — and know exactly how to support yourself through each one.

✍️ AI JOURNAL
Write, reflect, and process with an AI that actually understands you. Your entries are private and stored in your Memory Vault. The more you write, the deeper your insights become.

🥗 SMARTER NUTRITION
Get meal plans and food guidance tailored to your cycle phase. Discover what your body actually needs this week — not just generic diet advice. Try our Fridge Recipe tool to turn what you have into a hormone-balancing meal.

💪 MOVEMENT THAT WORKS WITH YOU
Workouts recommended based on your energy levels and cycle phase. Log your movement, track your progress, and stop forcing your body through workouts that work against your hormones.

🧘 NERVOUS SYSTEM CARE
Guided breathwork, somatic practices, and mindfulness tools. Box breathing, body scans, 4-7-8 breathing, and more — with calming audio narration. Because your nervous system needs care too.

💞 RELATIONSHIP COURSES
The Connect course uses Gottman method and attachment science to deepen your most important relationships. Do it solo or with your partner. The Parenting course brings the same evidence-based approach to raising confident, emotionally healthy kids.

🌿 DAILY HABITS
Build rituals that stick. Track your self-care habits daily and celebrate your streaks. Because small consistent actions create real change.

--- WHO SIGNAL IS FOR ---
Signal is for women who are tired of one-size-fits-all wellness advice. It's for the woman who wants to understand her body, not fight it. It's for the woman building a life that feels as good on the inside as it looks on the outside.

--- PLANS ---
Signal is free to download. Premium plans unlock AI-powered guidance, full course access, and monthly AI credits.
· Rooted — NZD $14.99/month

· Thriving — NZD $39.99/month

Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in the app.

--- PRIVACY ---
Your journal entries, cycle data, and health information are private and encrypted. We never sell your data. Signal is compliant with the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020.
